name: achat
description: Multi-provider LLM chat interface with single-file build

scripts.watch: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const {execSync}=require("child_process"); console.log("Watching src/ for changes..."); fs.watch("src", {recursive:true}, (e,f)=>{ console.log(`Changed: ${f}`); try { execSync("node build.js", {stdio:"inherit"}); } catch(err){} });'
